description: This file defines the PipelineElement interface, which models an element in a processing pipeline, including methods for state transitions (resolved, unresolved, deleted), evaluation, mapping, and composition. It also includes nested enum Type representing the possible states of a pipeline element.

classes.name: PipelineElement
classes.description: An interface representing a pipeline element capable of transitioning through various states (resolved, unresolved, deleted), accepting visitors, and being composed or transformed.

classes.name: PipelineElement.Type
classes.description: Enum defining the types of pipeline elements: DELETED, RESOLVED, UNRESOLVED.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of this pipeline element.

methods.name: onResolved
methods.description: Advances a resolved value to the next pipeline stage.

methods.name: onUnresolved
methods.description: Advances an unresolved value to the next pipeline stage.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Advances a deleted value to the next pipeline stage.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Evaluates the pipeline element using a visitor.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Transforms the resolved value using a provided function.

methods.name: orElse
methods.description: Combines this pipeline element with another, prioritizing deletion, then resolution, then fallback.

methods.name: toOptional
methods.description: Converts the pipeline element into an Optional<String>, conflating deletion and resolution failure.

methods.name: newVisitorBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for a visitor to evaluate pipeline elements.

methods.name: resolved
methods.description: Creates a pipeline element containing a resolved value.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Returns the unique pipeline element signifying deletion.

methods.name: unresolved
methods.description: Returns the unique pipeline element signifying unresolved state.
